decisions.statement: A call is known for sops by a marker among its own string arguments.
`--filename-override` is a flag no other tool here takes.
A string reached through an array literal counts as a string written straight into the call.
This rule asks for a call naming sops and a real file.
The call's own name is not asked.
A path built by joining or interpolating is not seen.
Only a whole literal sitting in the call is read.

definition: the rule refusing a sops call handed `/dev/stdin`, which it cannot open and seek
